closed_gaps.gap: Python optimization could disable assertion-based acceptance guards.
closed_gaps.resolution: An explicit non-assert RuntimeError rejects execution when __debug__ is false, before evidence processing.

closed_gaps.gap: The mutable locally imported audit generator was not bound to its reviewed source hash.
closed_gaps.resolution: All four checker/generator files must match the frozen snapshot hashes. The verifier extracts and executes only the hash-bound self-contained audit_source AST function, without importing the mutable checkout modules.

closed_gaps.gap: The actual Lean version was recorded but not compared with the pinned toolchain.
closed_gaps.resolution: The actual Lean version must contain the exact pinned version and following delimiter; the copied lean-toolchain must also match the snapshot exactly.

preserved_checks: Exact ordered module closure, successful return codes, no failed modules and matching CHECK records in the job log.
Every copied repository source hash matches the frozen snapshot.
Generated native audit source matches the reviewed generator output.
Every selected owner has audit records; declaration names are unique; the completion count matches the parsed records.
Audit records in the artifact and authenticated job log agree; parsed axiom dependencies stay within the foundational allowlist.
scope: Verification of authenticated completed remote artifacts against the reviewed frozen snapshot, combined with a separate immutable GitHub commit/tree correspondence check. The helper parses existing evidence and does not run Lean or Lake.

review_boundary.commit_tree_provenance: Required separately; not inferred from the artifact or certified by this helper review.
